releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.58

Artwork
- Movies and channels with no picture no longer show a blank box. More than
  half this provider's films ship no poster at all, so those tiles now carry
  the title, and a channel with no logo shows its initial.
- A picture whose host is down now looks the same as one that was never
  there, instead of looking like the app broke.

Downloads
- Films larger than 2 GB download. They used to fail instantly at 0%.
- Downloads keep running when you leave the app, and survive the app being
  swiped away.

Locking
- Select several channels, films, series, folders or episodes and lock them
  in one go, from a bar you can reach without scrolling back up.
- Episodes can be locked at all now, and unlocked from Locked Items.

Landscape
- Series detail and Downloads stop wasting a sideways screen.
